alt_text: A sofa with dark gray vertically ribbed upholstery. The right seat is reclined with its footrest extended. Illuminated vertical strips run along both front arm edges, and circular cup holders are built into the armrests; a control panel is mounted on the outside of the left arm. Open compartments beneath and in front of the seating contain a blanket, cushion, and books; one front compartment has its hinged lid raised.
